title: Hom transport and linear equivalence between literal coefficient pair categories
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $T$ be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme with $\ell$ invertible, in the sense of [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization]; such schemes are called allowed. For each finite $E\subset\Omega$ over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, use the framework integral category and raw rationalization $\mathcal C_E^s(T)$ of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] and the PBC integral category and raw rationalization $\mathcal C_E^p(T)$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category].
Use these categories also for each allowed $W$, with $T$ replaced by $W$. For each allowed scheme $W$ and every finite $E$, suppose given exact $E$-linear equivalences $J_{W,E}:\mathcal C_E^s(W)\simeq\mathcal C_E^p(W)$ and exact natural scalar comparisons $j_{W,L/E}:J_{W,L}S_{L/E}\simeq P_{L/E}J_{W,E}$. Here $S,P$ and their associators $a^s,a^p$ are the actual transitions of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi, lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition, prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. Assume the identity normalization, compatibility with shifts and the scalar cocycle
$$a^p_{M,L,E}\circ P_{M/L}(j_{W,L/E})\circ j_{W,M/L,S_{L/E}K}=j_{W,M/E}\circ J_{W,M}(a^s_{M,L,E}).$$
Write $\mathcal C_W,\mathcal P_W$ for the literal pair categories of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients, def-weil-pbc-qbar-category], with inclusions $\iota^s_E,\iota^p_E$. All categories are viewed in one sufficiently large universe. For a fixed allowed $W$, endpoints $X=(E,K),Y=(F,H)$, and $M\supset E,F$, put
$$\phi_M(u)=j_{W,M/F,H}J_{W,M}(u)j_{W,M/E,K}^{-1}.$$
These maps are additive bijections from $\operatorname{Hom}(S_{M/E}K,S_{M/F}H)$ to $\operatorname{Hom}(P_{M/E}J_{W,E}K,P_{M/F}J_{W,F}H)$. Their inverses are
$$\psi_M(v)=(J_{W,M}|_{\operatorname{Hom}})^{-1}(j_{W,M/F,H}^{-1}v j_{W,M/E,K}).$$
For every $N\supset M$, with the actual associator-conjugated transport maps, $\phi_N(u_N)=\phi_M(u)_N$ and $\psi_N(v_N)=\psi_M(v)_N$. Thus these maps induce inverse additive bijections on the actual Hom colimits, given by $[M,u]\mapsto[M,\phi_M(u)]$ and $[M,v]\mapsto[M,\psi_M(v)]$; no faithfulness of any transition functor is required. The object formula $J_W(E,K)=(E,J_{W,E}K)$ and the first map define an additive functor. It is essentially surjective already at each target field label: for every $(E,A)$ there are $K$ and a stage-$E$ isomorphism $J_{W,E}K\simeq A$ whose class identifies $J_W(E,K)$ with $(E,A)$. Consequently it is an equivalence. Choosing such object preimages and lifting the conjugated arrows by the inverse Hom bijections gives a quasi-inverse. Both functors and both Hom maps are $\Omega$-linear for the scalar actions represented by $\lambda u_N$ at a finite $N\supset M,\mathbf Q_\ell(\lambda)$. The identity-normalized finite-stage inclusions satisfy $J_W\iota^s_E=\iota^p_EJ_{W,E}$ on objects and morphisms. No idempotents are adjoined.

proof.text: Prove that J.functor is full and faithful on the existing quotient. For fullness, represent a target arrow at M and apply the inverse stage Hom equivalence there. For faithfulness, represent both source arrows; equality of their images gives equality after transport to a common P. tr_mapAt and injectivity of stageHomEquiv at P give equality of the original transported representatives. The actual quotient equality criterion then gives equality of the source arrows.

proof.text: For arbitrary specified finite-stage choices K_A and epsilon_A, set Kprime(A)=(A.stage,K_A) and let epsilonprime(A) be the inclusion image of epsilon_A. Define G.obj=Kprime and G.map f=J.functor.preimage(epsilonprime(A).hom ≫ f ≫ epsilonprime(B).inv). Apply faithfulness of J.functor and its preimage equations to prove identity and composition laws.

proof.text: Define the unit at X as the inverse of the preimage isomorphism of epsilonprime(JX); define the counit by epsilonprime. Applying J.functor and cancelling the epsilon components proves unit naturality, counit naturality, and the forward triangle equation. These data construct the specified equivalence directly. The inverse object and counit formulas are definitional. The inverse arrow formula follows by faithfulness and the inverse law of the Hom equivalence.

proof.text: For a scalar a in Omega, induct on an arrow representative at M and set N to the actual finite coefficient compositum of M and qbarScalarField(a). The intrinsicQbarLinear_existsUnique normalization identifies the published source scalar action with qbarScalarHom; the target action is the published qbarPairLinear construction. Unfold only the quotient scalar-action formula, which represents scalar multiplication by a times the transported arrow at N. Finite-stage linearity, bilinearity of beta conjugation, and tr_mapAt equate the two representatives. Thus J.functor is Omega-linear. Define its LinearEquiv explicitly with forward map J.functor.map and inverse J.functor.preimage; the functor preimage equations and the established additive and scalar laws prove its fields. Its forward representative formula is functor_map_mkHom; its inverse representative formula follows from injectivity and the stage inverse law.
